notes:
A CORRECTION, NOT A NEW ADJUDICATION. hostap EXP34-C precedents named in conflict by the 2026-10 coverage rows.

STANDARD. EXP34-C/2026-10-07/presets at strict, with the same open caller sets (ADR-0011, including hostapd's -rdynamic under CONFIG_WPA_TRACE); an in-function correlation with every writer listed is proof (interworking.c selected/selected_cred).

SCOPE. carried-forward EXP34-C rows that the coverage-exp34c-2026-10-* rows name as a conflicting precedent and whose reason did not rest on the caller set, re-read on their merits under the EXP34-C/2026-10-07 rulings. Rows at keys d21be1b3d no longer reports say so in provenance.

METHOD. Read-only research readers re-read every row at source at the pinned commit under a written brief and drafted a verdict; a fresh-context refuter re-read a sample of each batch (30 rows: every verdict change to FP, every kept FP below high confidence, and a random draw of the rest). The refuters found one shape applied inconsistently, a line that only passes the pointer to an in-tree function, so every EXP34-C row was then re-checked at source against the EXP34-C site ruling (the dereference is the violation site; passing a pointer as an ordinary argument is not one; the callee's own dereference is its site). Where such a line also dereferences another pointer that nothing proves non-null, the line is labeled on that dereference. Refuter citation fixes were applied. Two PRE00-C/PRE12-C rows were left out: a macro's call sites are all in-tree, so ADR-0011 does not reach them.

RESULT. 69 rows reviewed: FP->FP 16, FP->TP 47, TP->FP 6. Verdict changes by rule: EXP34-C 53. Every kept row's reason is restated to the basis it now rests on. The six TP -> FP rows are earlier relabels of correction-rdynamic-1554-hostap-b13 that called an in-function correlation insufficient (interworking.c cred chain, five rows) or rested on a correlated flag (events.c:2395, set only inside a data && condition).

Mechanics: in-place edits keep each key; each original batch takes a row_count decrement and a superseded_rows record. Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision claim is made here.
